sampling_method: predeclared manual balanced selection based on audit criteria

timeout_policy.failed_or_timed_out_cases: Retained as attempted error records and excluded from TP/FP/FN/TN.

scoring_policy.needs_review: counted separately without converting failed cases to safe
scoring_policy.failed_cases: excluded from TP/FP/FN/TN and retained in attempted/completion/error counts
scoring_policy.case_level: Hybrid metrics are case-level and not inflated by multiple findings.

uncertainty_handling_policy.NEEDS_REVIEW: separately counted; detector disagreement remains review-required

duplicate_grouping_policy.same_vulnerability_grouping: same relative file, same normalized CWE, nearby validated locations, compatible source/sink/evidence context, and no indication of separate vulnerable operations
duplicate_grouping_policy.primary_location: prefer exact over approximate and verified dangerous sink over source location

tuning_statement: Final Plan B cases were predeclared from audit criteria and were not used for tuning, pilot scans, or development validation.
